messages:
morgan (product): Quick sync 11 we need to align on an e-discovery + data lifecycle playbook for enterprise launch next quarter. customers want fast searches, tenant-scoped exports, legal-hold snapshots, and tiered retention (7/30/90). @ana (legal) @josh (security) gaps?
ana (legal): High level: legal needs preservation (holds that prevent deletion), a tamper-evident chain-of-custody with signer attestations, and a signed export format (ndjson or gzipped ndjson) produced within an SLA (48-72h). Also must map to SOC2 evidence and include manifest metadata.
josh (security): Infrastructure notes: we have archival S3 tiers but no queryable e-discovery index. Two patterns: full real-time index (fast queries, higher cost) or cold raw export + on-demand reindex job. Full indexing increases storage ~2.5-3x and CPU. BYOK affects export retrieval flows 1 escrow needed if customer keys prevent us from decrypting during legal requests. HSM-signed manifests recommended.
priya (platform): Implementation options: 1) Dedicated: full-index + query UI as a paid add-on; 2) Hosted: default async export + on-demand index; 3) Mix: allow customers to declare prefixes to index. API surface to spec: /v1/retention/policies, /v1/legal/holds, /v1/exports (async). Need clear semantics for policy inheritance and overrides (tenant -> org -> route).
kevin (sales): Customer signals: a large finance customer will commit if we demo a legal-hold snapshot and a signed export within SLA. They asked for billing as an add-on line item and acceptance criteria.
nana (legal): Proposed acceptance criteria for launch: - Immutable legal-hold snapshot that blocks deletion, - Signed export with manifest containing hashes and signer identity, - BYOK handshake doc + escrow flow described, - Retrieval SLA documented and regression tests, - Minimum chain-of-custody fields (event_id, timestamp, source, signer, hash).
priya (platform): Draft rollout timeline: Week 1-3: retention policy API + hold toggle + basic async export job. Week 4-8: export signing + manifest format + retrieval SLA tests. Q2: index pipeline + query UI (Dedicated first). Also need metrics to flag export billing and audit logs for every export.
josh (security): Security checklist: CMEK support for export-encrypted archives; optional customer-key escrow with multi-approver release; HSM signing of manifests; immutable storage for manifests (append-only). I'll produce a one-page BYOK+escrow flow. Perf data: full-index prototype on 50M events/day => ~30% CPU increase and 2.5x storage. Gate full-index to Dedicated / paid tier.
morgan (product): Action items: Priya -> draft API spec + example payloads by EOW; Josh -> BYOK+escrow sketch; Ana -> legal-hold acceptance language + SOC2 evidence mapping; Kevin -> confirm customer WTP details and exact export format preference. Ci-bot, please spin up an epic.
ci-bot: Created epic ED-LIFECYCLE-2387654321 and linked tickets: retention-api-238765, export-job-238766, byok-handshake-238767, ed-ui-proto-238768.
priya (platform): Example retention policy prototype payload: ```yaml
policy_id: "cust-123-default"
inherit_from: "org-default"
retention_days: 90
hold: false
index_prefixes: ["audit.events", "messages.summary"]
immutable_on_hold: true
```
josh (security): Note on exports: signed manifest format (ndjson): each line -> {"event_id":"..","hash":"sha256..","source":"..","timestamp":".."} plus top-level signature block signed by HSM.
nana (legal): We'll run compliance review once API + keyflow docs exist. Chain-of-custody and legal-hold are blockers for SOC2 evidence.
morgan (product): OK let's reconvene next Tue after docs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
